caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular tray with rounded corners, featuring a brown surface that has a warm, gradient appearance, transitioning from darker brown near the edges to a lighter brown toward the center. Around the edges of the tray, there is a textured or stitched border detail in a slightly darker hue. On the interior surface of the tray, the word “Lafayette” is written diagonally in large, flowing, yellowish letters that have a hand-drawn style. Above and below the script, there are wavy lines, also in yellow, running nearly parallel to the longer sides of the tray, and small dot-like accents at the end of the lines. The background of the image is plain, off-white or beige, with the tray centered and taking up the majority of the space.
title: Slipware Platter
